input: Research and book a ski lesson for beginners

gold.taskTitle: Research and Book a Beginner Ski Lesson
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and book a ski lesson suitable for beginners at a ski resort or school.

questions.title: Which ski resort or location are you targeting?
questions.description: Identify the specific resort, mountain, or geographic area where the lesson should take place.

questions.title: What are your intended lesson dates?
questions.description: Determine the specific date or date range when the user wants to take the lesson.

questions.title: How many people need a beginner lesson?
questions.description: Find out if this is for one person or a group, and the ages of those involved.

questions.title: Do you prefer a private or group lesson format?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a one-on-one instructor or is comfortable in a shared group setting.

questions.title: What is your budget per person for the lesson?
questions.description: Establish a price range to filter lesson options accordingly.

questions.title: Do you need equipment rental included with the booking?
questions.description: Determine if skis, boots, poles, or helmet rental need to be part of the package.

questions.title: How long should the lesson be in hours?
questions.description: Find out the preferred lesson duration, such as a half-day, full-day, or a set number of hours.
